integration: Expose pub mod blast_composition_redo and pub mod compo_heap. Main entry blast_redo_one_match<T,C:BlastRedoAlignCallbacks<T>> accepts per-query Vec output lists in source head-to-tail order, owned Params, incoming alignment slice, preliminary count, original scaled lambda, MatchingSequence descriptor, concatenated query length, mutable QueryInfo array, flat adjusted matrix, alphsize28, workspace and ratio/pvalue outputs, mutable callback object.

Callback trait implementation must implement actual Kappa sequence get-range: translated subject window fetch, near-identical detection and SEG masking policy. It must also implement actual Kappa s_RedoOneAlignment with original scaled gaps/Xdrop and existing protein x-drop traceback. This module neither replaces those algorithms nor invokes an unadjusted alignment fallback.

Parents coordinate callback implementation separately. SequenceData is padded owned Vec with data_offset1 from from_sequence; data() view intentionally excludes sentinels, buffer retains sentinel access. QueryInfo origin/eff_search_space/words retain original meanings; MatchingSequence.length is full nucleotide length for tblastn and index is DB id. Callback object holds actual nucleotide sequence/DB local state.

MatrixInfo must be initialized using actual BLOSUM62 frequency ratios, ideal lambda /32; caller initializes gapping_params with original scaled gaps and Xdrop and incoming HSP score scale. Per-match redo retains source score units and does not rescale significance or final report scores.

Remaining frontend scope: Kappa callbacks, shared score/gap/Lambda scaling and restore, conversion of BlastHSP to/from input/output contexts, original endpoint/score/evalue filtering, HSP linking/default sum-statistics and result insertion/significance conversion. These are not complete from isolated per-match control validation.

Smith-Waterman alternate redo, smith_waterman.c forbidden ranges and SW-only heap calls excluded. Original compo_heap.rs and BlastCompo_EarlyTermination are implemented here, ready for frontend multi-subject result insertion and early termination.

Source free functions are represented by typed RAII; no no-op free translations added. Generic callback/Arc API changes only memory representation and explicit dependencies, retaining original per-match decision math and order.
